verdict.rationale: The evidence shows generic API keys used over HTTP Basic Auth, plus endpoints to list accounts and initiate ACH, wire, FedNow and book transfers. Nothing in the pack documents scoped or least-privilege credentials, per-key transfer amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or any agent or AI use case by name. The Card Auth Loop covers card authorizations, not policy-bounded transfers, so the policy-governed agent access this story asks for is unevidenced.
